t: Introduction and overview — HH-60 Pave Hawk
name: Introduction and overview — HH-60 Pave Hawk — aircraft record
title: Introduction and overview — HH-60 Pave Hawk
description: Introduction and overview of the HH-60 Pave Hawk: What this aircraft is, its role, and why it matters in aviation history. The HH-60 Pave Hawk is a twin-engine combat search-and-rescue helicopter built by Sikorsky, entering service in 1982. Equipped for night/all-weather rescue behind enemy lines, it recovered downed aircrew in Desert Storm, the Balkans, Afghanistan, and Iraq. About 112 were built; the HH-60W Jolly Green II replaces it. Baseline facts: Combat search-and-rescue helicopter; service from 1982; ~112 built by Sikorsky..
how_it_works: Wings generate lift from airflow; the engine provides thrust; control surfaces and fly-by-wire or mechanical controls steer the aircraft in three axes.
key_points: HH-60 Pave Hawk: What this aircraft is, its role, and why it matters in aviation history.
Combat search-and-rescue helicopter; service from 1982; ~112 built by Sikorsky.
